_comment: What a tip jar (a customer_chooses price) may offer. Read by BOTH the builder (dashboard/src/config/tips.js) and the server (domain/tips.py), because a form that caps at five and a server that accepts eight is the same bug this codebase keeps shipping: two things that must agree with nothing forcing them to. See plans/PAY_WHAT_YOU_WANT.md.
_amounts: In the smallest currency unit, like every other amount in a Price document.
_presets: Preset buttons sit in ONE row on the page. Five fit; 'enter your own' takes one of the five when it is offered, so the cap drops to four.
_intervals: Offered when the tenant lets a supporter make the tip recurring. Stripe's four intervals, unabridged -- a donation that repeats weekly is as ordinary as one that repeats monthly.
_recommended: Starting amounts, so a tenant does not have to invent a ladder. Keyed by CURRENCY, then by frequency, because the same number means different things in each: $50 is an ordinary one-off tip and a steep monthly commitment. Bottoms follow the platforms' own defaults -- Ko-fi opens at $3, Buy Me a Coffee at $5. Trimmed to the preset cap, so turning on 'enter your own' drops the top amount. An unlisted currency falls back to usd, which reads oddly for a currency of a different magnitude -- the same open question the min/max range has (plans/PAY_WHAT_YOU_WANT.md 5d).
